caption: The drawing depicts a single high-heeled women's boot, oriented with the toe pointing to the left. The boot is predominantly dark brown or black and includes various details such as decorative stitching and scalloped edges along the top and side opening. There are seven dark buttons running up the front side of the boot, where a ruffled or wavy button flap is bordered with lighter lines of embroidery or stitching. The boot has a rounded toe and a solid, slightly angled heel rendered in a wood-like color. The upper edge of the boot is scalloped, revealing an inner lining colored in a darker brown or maroon shade. The background is plain, light-colored paper, and there is a faint signature reading "John Cooke" with the date "1937" located below the boot.
title: Woman's Shoe
